a.lede: Nvidia’s cofounder and chief executive resigned on Thursday after the company opened an investigation into his affair with an alleged Chinese intelligence asset.
a.title: Jensen Huang Resigns as Nvidia CEO

b.lede: With a big checkbook and sought-after chips, Nvidia’s CEO had his thumb on the world of AI. An extramarital affair with a suspected Chinese spy may put all of that at risk.
b.title: Jensen Huang’s Troubles Leave the AI Industry Reeling
